bottom_half_wealth.label: Bottom 50% of US households, combined net worth
bottom_half_wealth.source: Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts, Q2 2026

amazon_warehouse_annual_pay.method: Average hourly pay ~$24 (Amazon, Sep 2026) x 2,080 hours

anticancer_therapies_annual.source: IQVIA data reported in Nat Rev Clin Oncol 2024 (all anticancer therapies, not chemotherapy alone)

healthcare_family_of_four_annual.source: KFF Employer Health Benefits Survey 2025 (average family premium)

house_homeless_veterans_annual.method: 32,495 homeless veterans (HUD Point-in-Time 2025) x $15,000 per person-year (assumption)

lifetime_earnings_average_worker.method: BLS OEWS May 2025 mean annual wage, all occupations ($69,770) x 40 years

lifetime_earnings_doctor.method: BLS OOH 2025 median pay, physicians and surgeons ($275,930) x 40 years

lifetime_earnings_hedge_fund_manager.method: Reported average total compensation, portfolio managers at large hedge funds (~$2.4M/yr) x 40 years
lifetime_earnings_hedge_fund_manager.note: Softest figure on the page; no official statistical series exists.

lifetime_earnings_lawyer.method: BLS OOH 2025 median pay, lawyers ($159,670) x 40 years

median_household_income.source: US Census Bureau, Income in the United States: 2025

median_net_worth.source: Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances 2025

mortality.source: WHO World Malaria Report 2025 (2024 data; ~75% of deaths are children under five)

david_solomon.label: Wealth of Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon
david_solomon.note: No Forbes figure exists; published estimates range roughly $85M-$400M depending on treatment of unvested stock.

jeff_bezos.label: Wealth of Jeff Bezos, founder of Amazon

tim_cook.label: Wealth of Tim Cook, former Apple CEO

all_programs_combined.note: Sum of the items above at their stated costs; after funding all of them proportionally, every member of the Forbes 400 would still be a billionaire.

clean_water_and_sanitation.source: WHO estimate (as in the original page); need updated to 2.1B people lacking safely managed drinking water, WHO/UNICEF 2025

programs.note: Costs as used in the 'What could we do' section, with shares of the Forbes 400 total ($8T). Pandemic-era items keep their original cost estimates, labeled with their year.

refund_taxes_under_80k.source: Tax Foundation / IRS (2018, as in the original page)

scale.note: Area figures: value = pixels^2 * 1000 for squares, width * height * 1000 for rectangles. Long bars: value = width_px * 500000 (bar height is 500px, so the two scales agree).

title: Wealth, shown to scale — data behind the page
